exercises.q: Oh, if only I were a queen.
exercises.why: **царицей** — цари́ца: tsarina, tsaritsa; empress, queen (in ancient or non-European monarchies); (entomology) queen. Wiktionary: царь + -ица.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.
The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **монахиня** — мона́хиня: nun (member of a Christian religious community of women). Wiktionary: мона́х + -ыня.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **старуха** — стару́ха: old woman; (informal, jocular) old lady (a close female friend or one's wife; also used as a term of address). Wiktionary: старый + -у́ха.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: nun (member of a Christian religious community of women)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: цари́ца — tsarina, tsaritsa; графи́ня — countess; мона́хиня — nun (member of a Christian religious community of women); стару́ха — old woman.
